patterns.note: Each primary product or content category is introduced with a full-bleed, full-height hero section featuring distinct background imagery and a prominent title and call-to-action.

Display headings are exceptionally large, bold, and often uppercase, creating strong visual anchors against dark backgrounds, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif text for navigation and body content.
A predominantly dark background (#060606) serves as a canvas for vibrant, high-contrast accent colors used for call-to-action buttons (neon green, bright blue) and white/light gray text.

As the user scrolls, the background image of the current full-screen hero section fades out to a solid dark background, temporarily isolating the call-to-action button before the next hero section's content and imagery scroll into view.
The homepage is structured as a vertical stack of distinct, full-screen hero sections, each dedicated to a major game or company aspect, creating a 'one-page experience' for top-level navigation.

technique_notes: Sections are designed as full-viewport height containers. A scroll-triggered animation (likely using css-keyframes or JavaScript) causes the background image of the current section to smoothly fade to a solid dark color as it leaves the viewport, leaving only the call-to-action button briefly visible against the dark, before the next section's content and background image fully reveal. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
Call-to-action buttons feature solid, high-contrast background colors (neon green or bright blue) with white uppercase text, providing clear visual targets against the dark page theme.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, often uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between full-height hero sections, balanced density within content grids on interior pages.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the full-screen hero image fade-out on scroll, which creates a dramatic, almost cinematic transition between major content sections, temporarily highlighting the call-to-action button against a stark dark background.
